A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 27-page versions of DiffAdapt. Text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G can be reliably matched. Pages 3–27 have identical extracted text and rendered pixels.

before.justification: v3 reports original entropy analyses, oracle experiments, benchmark evaluations, efficiency measurements, and ablations in Sections 3–7 and Appendices D–G.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, token and latency measurements, and the 50-query reasoning-quality evaluation.

M1.justification: The proxy-sampling and labeling procedure, MLP probe, training objective, and Easy/Normal/Hard inference strategies are unchanged in Sections 4–5, Appendix C, and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use DeepMath-103K and retain the same evaluation coverage: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME 2024/2025, OlympiadBench, Minerva, GPQA, and MMLU-Pro. No training or evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including fixed Easy/Normal/Hard strategies, DEER, the heuristic baselines in Table 8, and ThinkLess TL-1.5B-RL in Table 10.

E3.justification: Data sampling, model configurations, decoding settings, metrics, token budgets, and evaluation procedures are identical, including the per-benchmark limits in Table 13 and the judging protocol in Appendix E.

E4.justification: The threshold-transfer, linear-probe, reduced-training-data, domain-transfer, and reasoning-integrity analyses are retained unchanged in Section 7 and Appendices D–G.

E5.justification: Both versions specify ten samples per problem for entropy/correctness estimation and three evaluation runs with reported means. Run-count, seed, and uncertainty-reporting information is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted results match, including 22.4% Qwen3-4B token savings in Table 3 and 38/50 DiffAdapt wins in Tables 6 and 14. No appendix results are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The entropy and correctness definitions, probe equations, cross-entropy objective, and token-savings formula are identical. No formal assumptions, mathematical reasoning, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about U-shaped entropy, difficulty-adaptive strategy selection without base-model retraining, and accuracy preservation or improvement with token savings.

C2.justification: Interpretations of overthinking, strategy diversity, efficiency, and generalization are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same limitations concerning calibration, prefill-only prediction, proxy labeling, and tight-budget failures.

D1.justification: Prompts, hyperparameters, hardware information, threshold values, token-limit tables, and evaluation details are unchanged. The reproducibility statement and promised code release also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations, and the bibliography are unchanged. The positioning relative to training-based budget control, inference-time methods, and auxiliary-model approaches is identical.

P1.justification: v4 adds the front-matter note '†Corresponding authors', explaining existing author markers, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added author note shifts content on the first two pages and moves one introduction line from page 1 to page 2. All figures, tables, captions, and subsequent page layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 clarifies the corresponding-author markers, but otherwise only updates the version stamp and slightly reflows the opening pages. The scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
